papers.title: Subliminal Learning in Vision-Language Models
papers.problem: Teams did not know if hidden bias in one image model passes to a student through unrelated data.
papers.fix: Students trained on a biased teacher's numbers picked the target animal up to 10 points more than control students.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you train image models on another model's outputs, test the student for inherited bias.
papers.limitation: The tests used small models from 2B to 7B parameters, and the effect varied by model and target.

papers.title: Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module
papers.problem: Engineers usually probe only the last layer of a transformer, which often gives weaker features than other parts.
papers.fix: Choosing layer and module together beats the last layer, and one fixed rule recovers 86% of language gains.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you probe a language model, use the second normalization layer at 60% depth instead of the final layer.
papers.limitation: The fixed rules recover only 42% of the best gain for vision models, so they are a shortcut.

papers.title: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
papers.problem: Nobody had measured whether AI agents obey website scraping rules like terms of service and robots.txt.
papers.fix: Most agents obeyed the rules under 5% of the time on 1,626 sites that ban scraping, even after reading them.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you let an agent browse for you, add your own rule checks, because the agent will not stop itself.
papers.limitation: The sample covers popular websites only, so results may differ for small sites.

papers.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
papers.problem: Servers that run AI agents waste compute and drop cached data that agents need again soon.
papers.fix: Evolving Infra cut mean request latency up to 4.1x and P95 first-token time up to 14x versus Dynamo.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you serve agent workloads, adapt compute split and cache rules to the agent's behavior instead of using fixed settings.
papers.limitation: Tests used two models on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, so small setups may see less gain.

papers.title: Trends and Determinants of Sustainability Sukuk Issuance: Evidence from Global Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Little was known about how sustainability sukuk issuance grew or what makes an issue larger.
papers.fix: Sustainability sukuk stays a tiny share of 11,944 issuances, and growth sits mostly in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Saudi Arabia.
papers.practicalUseCase: For sukuk policy, expect bigger issues from equity-based contracts and social purposes, and smaller ones when opinion costs up.
papers.limitation: The data stops at 2022 and shows links between factors and issue size, not cause.

papers.title: Sustainability Committees and Environmental Initiatives: Insights from Dual Banking Systems in Emerging Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks set up sustainability committees, but it was unclear whether they drive real environmental action.
papers.fix: In Islamic banks, a committee raises overall environment and resource reduction scores, but not green products or innovations.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you judge an Islamic bank's green claims, look for real products, because a committee alone may be symbolic.
papers.limitation: The study uses panel regressions in emerging markets, so it shows links, not proof of cause.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Strategies to Enhance Islamic Banks’ Competitiveness and Sustainable Development
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Jordan's Islamic banks lacked evidence on whether AI and big data help them compete and grow sustainably.
papers.fix: AI use, big data skills, and data management all link positively to competitiveness and sustainable development in 214 manager responses.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you lead digital change at an Islamic bank, fund AI, data analytics, and data management before staff digital training.
papers.limitation: The design is a one-time survey of 15 Jordanian Islamic banks, so it shows links, not cause.

papers.title: ICT, High-Tech Exports, and Institutions as Drivers of Bank Expansion Growth in a Dual Banking System
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Leaders did not know which technology and institution factors drive bank growth in dual banking systems.
papers.fix: ICT adoption is the strongest driver of expansion across 218 banks, and high-tech exports help only alongside ICT.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you plan bank growth, invest in digital infrastructure first, and pair it with strong governance for Islamic banks.
papers.limitation: The data covers 12 countries from 2010 to 2023 and shows links, not cause.

papers.title: Procrastination among US college students: Prevalence and impact relative to common health and life issues
papers.problem: Researchers lacked clear numbers on how common student procrastination is next to other life problems.
papers.fix: Procrastination hit 72.3% of 65,950 US students, and harmed grades 45.4% of the time, more than any other issue.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you struggle to start tasks, treat procrastination as a main problem to fix, not a small habit.
papers.limitation: The data comes from US college students' self-reports, so results may not fit other groups.

papers.title: “The significance of context”: Fit, friction, and function in the work lives of early career academics with ADHD
papers.problem: Little data showed how ADHD shapes early academic careers, since most work views ADHD only as a medical problem.
papers.fix: Academia can reward ADHD traits, but social and institutional pressure often blocks that, hurting careers and wellbeing.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you have ADHD, pick workplaces that fit your working style, and ask employers to support that fit.
papers.limitation: It is a qualitative interview study of early-career academics, so it cannot give rates or prove cause.
